title: Manitowoc to debut new Potain Evy 28-21 self-erecting crane and customer support innovations at Batimat 2026
summary: Manitowoc will present the new Potain Evy 28-21 at the Batimat construction trade show, a 2.2 t capacity self-erecting crane.The Potain Evy 28-21 is engineered for residential construction, carpentry, and roofing and combines practical lifting performance with rapid, efficient jobsite deployment.Alongside the new crane, Manitowoc will use Batimat to showcase its latest customer support products and accessories designed to maximise uptime, productivity, and total cost of ownership.
body_markdown:
- Manitowoc will present the new Potain Evy 28-21 at the Batimat construction trade show, a 2.2 t capacity self-erecting crane.
- The Potain Evy 28-21 is engineered for residential construction, carpentry, and roofing and combines practical lifting performance with rapid, efficient jobsite deployment.
- Alongside the new crane, Manitowoc will use Batimat to showcase its latest customer support products and accessories designed to maximise uptime, productivity, and total cost of ownership.


Manitowoc will showcase its latest self-erecting crane innovations and productivity solutions at[Batimat 2026](https://www.batimat.com/en-gb.html) in Paris, France, from September 28 to October 1. Taking center stage will be the new 2.2 t capacity Potain Evy 28-21 showcased alongside an expanded portfolio of customer support products and accessories.


Renowned for their speed, agility, and ease of use, Potain self-erecting cranes excel on compact jobsites where space is limited. The range incorporates advanced engineering to simplify transport, site access, assembly, dismantling, and maintenance. Designed for residential builders, carpenters, and roofers, the Evy 28-21 combines practical lifting performance with fast, efficient deployment. The crane is also fully compliant with the upcoming European standard EN 14439:2025, which specifies safety requirements for tower cranes and comes into effect in January 2027.


The crane offers a maximum capacity of 2.2 t and a tip load of 950 kg at its 28 m jib end when utilizing the built-in P+ function. To accommodate varied site conditions, the crane features a standard horizontal working height of 21 m with three options to raise the jib to either 10°, 20°, or 30°. At the 30° incline maximum hook height for the crane is 32.3 m.


Getting the crane to site is easy, with the entire counterweight travelling on only one truck. To streamline operations on-site, the Evy 28-21 comes with Smart Set-Up remote guidance for automated erection. The on-board Crane Control System (CCS), Drive Control, and Power Control offer assured movements across transport, set-up, and operation and for better crane management, there’s the integrated[Potain CONNECT™](https://www.manitowoc.com/support/grove-connect-potain-connect) platform, providing remote diagnostics, advanced insights, and centralized equipment tracking.
